settings.allowInterjectionDesc: When enabled, you can keep sending messages while the AI is replying, whether to add context, attach new evidence, or ask a follow-up. When disabled, the input stays locked until the current reply finishes.
settings.autoBackgroundLongTasksLabel: Automatically move long tasks to background
settings.autoBackgroundLongTasksDesc: When enabled, Magi uses rules and the model to decide whether longer tasks should continue in the background. When disabled, you can still move a running task manually.
settings.allowAskInBackgroundDesc: When enabled, a task running in the background may open a question dialog and wait for your answer. When disabled, background tasks may not block on user input and will error out if they try.

personalitySettings.runtimeDesc: These switches control whether a light persona analysis runs after each turn and whether its results feed state transitions and deeper persona behavior.

personalitySettings.stateTransitionDesc: Requires persona state memory. When enabled, Magi can trigger temporary persona state shifts based on conversation analysis.
personalitySettings.deepPersonaDesc: Requires persona state memory. When enabled, Magi can unlock deeper persona behavior using relationship depth and key milestones.

form.title: Memory Configuration
form.description: Choose what your AI remembers and how it learns from conversations.
form.onboardingHint: Only common options are shown here. After setup, go to Settings → Memory for full configuration.
form.l1DependencyTitle: Conversation history is the foundation of all memory
form.l1DependencyDescription: When disabled, knowledge extraction, summaries, and experience learning are all unavailable.

general.description: Manage the local memory storage location and review the embedding model the memory stack depends on.
general.pipelineDescription: This area controls where memory databases and vector indexes are stored on disk.
general.embeddingModelDescription: Semantic retrieval in L1 and L3 depends on the embedding model configured here.
general.embeddingModelEmpty: No embedding model is configured yet. Select one first under Model Configuration > Model Selection.
general.rerankerDescription: Optionally add a retrieval reranker stage for higher precision on top candidates. If the LLM configuration is incomplete, runtime can fall back to heuristic reranking.
general.embeddingDescription: Choose between a remote model service or a local ONNX model for vector generation. Local models load on first use and auto-unload after idle.

workbench.description: Configure short-lived workbench memory retention and recovery cadence so runtime context can be checkpointed and replayed safely.

events.description: Configure retention, importance scoring, and semantic retrieval for raw event memory, which feeds every downstream layer.
events.retrievalDescription: Decide which events deserve extra attention and whether they can participate in semantic search.

knowledge.description: Configure whether knowledge memory extracts facts automatically and whether extracted knowledge participates in semantic search.
knowledge.extractionDescription: Control whether the knowledge layer is enabled and whether the model participates in entity, relation, and assertion extraction.
knowledge.flushDescription: Control how long staged microbatches wait before being written into the formal knowledge graph.
knowledge.arbitrationDescription: When the knowledge layer sees high-confidence conflicts, decide whether to trigger a more cautious arbitration pass.

reflection.description: Configure summary and reflection generation so long event streams can be compressed into higher-level abstractions.

skills.description: Configure skill memory extraction and decide which successful or failed patterns become reusable experience.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently clear all memory data for this instance. This action cannot be undone, and the AI will need to rebuild its memory from scratch.

vector.title: Vector maintenance
vector.description: Review indexed memory vectors and rebuild them after changing the embedding model or local model files.
vector.preflightStrongConfirm: This change affects {{count}} existing vectors in {{layers}}. Semantic search may be stale until vectors are rebuilt. Save anyway?
vector.preflightStrongDescription: This save changes the embedding identity for {{count}} existing vectors in {{layers}}.
vector.preflightStrongBody: Existing vectors will stay isolated from the new embedding identity, so semantic memory search may be incomplete until you rebuild them.
vector.preflightRebuildHint: After saving, open Memory > General > Vector maintenance and click Rebuild Vectors.
vector.preflightSoftWarning: Embedding provider details changed for {{layers}}. Existing {{count}} vectors can stay available, but rebuild if retrieval quality looks off.

db_path.label: Memory data storage location
db_path.description: Set the local directory that stores memory databases and vector indexes. Vector writes always use the async sqlite path.
db_path.runtimeHint: In the current build, saving this only updates config. Existing memory is not migrated automatically, and the running backend does not switch to the new directory immediately.
db_path.summary_hint: Includes the L1 event store and the shared memory database.

embedding_mode.label: Embedding mode
embedding_mode.description: Choose between a remote API service or a local ONNX model for generating vector embeddings.

embedding_local_variant.label: Quantization
embedding_local_variant.description: Picks the best variant for your platform automatically. Override if you want a specific quantization.

embedding_local_managed_cache_path.label: Local model cache directory
embedding_local_managed_cache_path.description: Managed local embedding model assets are stored under ~/.magi/cache/models/embed/.

reranker_enabled.label: Enable LLM reranking
reranker_enabled.description: Add an optional reranker stage after retrieval fusion so top candidates can be re-evaluated before final ranking.

l1.label: L1 event memory
l1.description: Best for long event streams and chunk-folded semantic matches.

l3.label: L3 reflection memory
l3.description: Useful when multiple summaries are semantically close and need another pass.

l4.label: L4 skill memory
l4.description: Enable only when procedural retrieval needs another precision pass.

reranker_local_managed_cache_path.label: Managed local model cache
reranker_local_managed_cache_path.description: Managed local reranker assets are stored under ~/.magi/cache/models/rerank/.

cross_encoder_enabled.label: Enable Cross-Encoder Reranking
cross_encoder_enabled.description: Use a local Cross-Encoder model to semantically rerank retrieval results, improving memory recall quality.

query_expansion_enabled.label: Enable Query Expansion
query_expansion_enabled.description: Use an LLM to generate additional retrieval phrasings for memory queries, improving recall at the cost of one extra model call.

query_expansion_max_expansions.label: Expansion count
query_expansion_max_expansions.description: Maximum extra retrieval phrasings to generate for each memory query. More expansions broaden recall but can add latency and model cost.

graph_spreading_enabled.label: Enable associative recall
graph_spreading_enabled.description: Supplement normal search by following knowledge relationships when a question needs broader context.

fields.cross_encoder_no_model_hint: Configure a Cross-Encoder model first in LLM Configuration → Model Selection → Reranker.
fields.reranker_not_available: Please enable Cross-Encoder reranking in Memory → General Memory Settings first, then return here to select a model.

enable_l0.label: Enable temporary working memory
enable_l0.description: Keep current conversation context in memory with automatic checkpoints for crash recovery.

enable_l1.label: Enable conversation history
enable_l1.description: Save complete conversation records as the data source for all long-term memory.

enable_l2.label: Enable knowledge extraction
enable_l2.description: Automatically extract people, preferences, and facts you mention to build AI's understanding of you.

enable_l3.label: Enable summary & review
enable_l3.description: Periodically generate conversation summaries and reviews to help AI grasp long-term trends.

enable_l4.label: Enable experience learning
enable_l4.description: Learn reusable strategies from successes and failures to make AI increasingly helpful.

retention_days.label: Legacy global memory retention (days)
retention_days.description: Kept for legacy configuration compatibility; cleanup tasks now use each layer's own retention setting below.

l1_retention_days.label: Event retention (days)
l1_retention_days.description: Raw events older than this may be deleted or archived once higher-level memory has already used them and no active memory still needs them.

l3_retention_days.label: Review summary retention (days)
l3_retention_days.description: Ordinary review summaries older than this are eligible for cleanup; user-confirmed, pending, or experience-related summaries are kept.

l4_inactive_skill_retention_days.label: Low-activity skill retention (days)
l4_inactive_skill_retention_days.description: Skills that have not been used recently and stay below the activity threshold below are cleaned up after this many days.

l4_inactive_skill_min_attempts.label: Minimum uses to keep a skill
l4_inactive_skill_min_attempts.description: Skills that reach this many uses are kept even if they have not been used recently.

history_behavior.label: Historical memory behavior
history_behavior.description: Delete removes expired active history immediately. Archive writes it to a separate archive database before removing it from the active memory store.

archive_path.label: Archive location
archive_path.description: Expired history is written into date-based archive databases here, then removed from active memory.

enable_l1_vectorization.label: Enable semantic search
enable_l1_vectorization.description: Convert conversation records into vectors to enable searching history by meaning.
enable_l1_vectorization.description_disabled: Requires an embedding model to be configured first.

enable_l2_vectorization.label: Enable semantic search
enable_l2_vectorization.description: Convert extracted knowledge entries into vectors for semantic similarity search.
enable_l2_vectorization.description_disabled: Requires an embedding model to be configured first.

shadow_conflict_notification_enabled.label: Ask me to confirm memory conflicts
shadow_conflict_notification_enabled.description: When a new inference disagrees with a preference you explicitly confirmed, send it to Pending so you can choose the right memory.

l2_portrait_projection_refresh_delay_sec.label: Portrait refresh delay (seconds)
l2_portrait_projection_refresh_delay_sec.description: How long to wait before updating About You after assertion changes. Multiple changes in that window are merged.

l2_batch_flush_interval_seconds.label: Knowledge extraction batch interval (seconds)
l2_batch_flush_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait before processing a batch of new conversations for knowledge extraction. Minimum 30 seconds.

enable_l2_conflict_arbitration.label: Enable fact conflict resolution
enable_l2_conflict_arbitration.description: When new information highly contradicts existing memory, use AI to analyze deeply before deciding whether to update.

l2_conflict_arbitration_min_confidence.label: Conflict resolution threshold
l2_conflict_arbitration_min_confidence.description: Only trigger deep analysis when contradiction confidence reaches this level.

enable_l3_llm_summary.label: Enable AI summaries
enable_l3_llm_summary.description: Use AI to condense conversation records into periodic summaries and reviews.

enable_l3_vectorization.label: Enable semantic search
enable_l3_vectorization.description: Convert summaries and reviews into vectors for semantic similarity search.
enable_l3_vectorization.description_disabled: Requires an embedding model to be configured first.

personality.title: Personality Config
personality.newPersonalityDesc: Fill in the personality details and click Save to create
personality.generatePlaceholder: Describe a personality for AI generation

sectionDescriptions.basicProfile: Name and description mainly support the selector and list UI. The runtime persona is driven by identity core, baseline voice, conversation modes, and rules below.
sectionDescriptions.identityCore: Define the stable core of the persona here. Focus on enduring identity, values, and attention habits rather than surface wording.
sectionDescriptions.idiolect: This is the low-intensity language fingerprint. It should stay recognizable, but not so strong that every reply feels like a performance.
sectionDescriptions.registers: Each conversation mode maps to a situation: casual chat, analysis, execution, emotional support, or crisis handling. Few-shot examples work best as one user line plus one AI line per block.
sectionDescriptions.signatureTriggers: Trigger reactions only activate in specific situations. They describe when the persona becomes more visible and what changes when it does.
sectionDescriptions.quietHours: Quiet-hour rules intentionally reduce persona intensity during focused execution, serious support, crisis handling, or explicit low-style requests.
sectionDescriptions.appearance: Only used for image-generation or portrait prompts. It does not affect chat behavior.
sectionDescriptions.personaLayers: Deep persona layers are relationship-depth modifiers, not a second full persona skin.

fieldHelp.name: Persona name shown in the selector and runtime surfaces. Keep it short and recognizable.
fieldHelp.description: Short summary text for persona cards and lists. Keep it to one line and avoid repeating the identity statement.
fieldHelp.avatar: Only changes the persona's display avatar. It does not affect conversation behavior.
fieldHelp.identityStatement: Injected directly into the runtime Persona Plan under Identity Core. Write who this persona is, how they interpret the world, and what remains stable over time.
fieldHelp.valuesLoved: What this persona genuinely values. This affects judgment, stance, and what they endorse.
fieldHelp.valuesRejected: What this persona naturally rejects. This affects refusal style, criticism targets, and boundaries.
fieldHelp.attentionBiases: What this persona notices first when interpreting a situation. This affects analysis angle and prioritization.
fieldHelp.sentenceStyle: Low-intensity sentence rhythm and cadence. It should stay present without overpowering usefulness.
fieldHelp.chatBehavior: Default day-to-day reply behavior. This is the most direct control over how the persona normally sounds.
fieldHelp.vocabAvailable: Words or phrases that may appear naturally. Treat them as ammunition, not quotas.
fieldHelp.vocabAvoided: Words that break the persona voice, such as service-desk phrasing or generic filler.
fieldHelp.structuralQuirks: Structural habits such as short sentences, conclusion-first writing, or only using lists when needed.
fieldHelp.registerDescription: A short description of when this mode is used. Good for scene boundaries and planner clarity.
fieldHelp.registerBehavior: How the AI should behave in this mode. Prefer rules like what to prioritize, suppress, or allow.
fieldHelp.registerExamples: Few-shot examples. Separate examples with a blank line and use a simple format like “[User: ...]\nNova: ...”.
fieldHelp.triggerId: Stable internal identifier such as crisis, intimacy, or shutdown_threat. Keep it short and unique.
fieldHelp.activatesWhen: Describe the concrete situation that activates the trigger. Avoid vague mood labels when possible.
fieldHelp.behaviorShift: Describe what changes once the trigger is active. Focus on behavior change rather than repeating lore.
fieldHelp.intensityLevels: Optional. Use only when this trigger behaves differently at low, mid, or high strength, using key:value lines.
fieldHelp.exitBehavior: How the persona returns to baseline after the trigger passes: gradual fade, brief afterglow, immediate reset, and so on.
fieldHelp.quietHourCondition: When personality should recede, usually during execution, crisis handling, serious support, or explicit low-style requests.
fieldHelp.clamps: These are explicit runtime clamp keys. Prefer known keys such as persona_intensity_max and answer_utility instead of casually inventing new ones.
fieldHelp.appearancePrompt: Only used for image generation. It does not change the chat persona. Prefer English for model compatibility.

help.layerId: Unique identifier for this layer, e.g. crack, revealed. Represents the depth stage of persona unlock.
help.unlockCondition: When all conditions are met simultaneously, this layer activates and its overrides are injected into the prompt.
help.trustLevelGte: Trust ranges from 0 to 1, starting at 0.5. Each successful interaction adds +0.02, failure subtracts −0.01.
help.interactionCountGte: Total chat turns between the user and AI. Each turn (user message + AI reply) counts as 1.
help.milestoneRequired: Milestones are detected by the AI during conversation. Enter a key defined in milestone_conditions of the persona config.
help.layerModifiers: Additional prompt-level modifiers for this relationship layer. Choose from the supported keys and keep values small and runtime-usable, such as memory_behavior, protective_bias, voice_unlocks, humor_delta, or directness_delta.
help.behaviorHints: Specific actions the character will take when this layer is unlocked. One per line, describing concrete behaviors at this depth.
